description_en: Queries the details of cloud computer specifications
description_zh: 查询云电脑规格的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktop-types --business-channel Enterprise --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-type-id ecd.graphics.xlarge --instance-type-family ecd.graphics --cpu-count 2 --memory-size 4096 --gpu-count 1.0 --desktop-id-for-modify ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --order-type DOWNGRADE --applied-scope Public --desktop-group-id-for-modify dg-abcdefg0000 --gpu-driver-type A10 --order-by Memory --sort-type ASC --scope FastBuy --desktop-type-id-list eds.enterprise.4c8g --support-min-session-count 2 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-j --gpu-memory 2048 --scope-set PUBLIC --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+os-c5cy7q578s8jc0000 --desktop-scenario office --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktopTypes

parameters.help_en:
The business channel. Valid values:
Enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
Business: Business Edition
parameters.help_zh:
业务渠道, 取值：
Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The specification ID.

If both `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` are left empty, information about all cloud computer specifications is returned
parameters.help_zh:
规格ID。

当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息
parameters.name: desktop_type_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance family name.

If both `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` are left empty, information about all cloud computer specifications is returned
parameters.help_zh:
规格族名称。

当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息
parameters.name: instance_type_family

parameters.help_en: The number of vCPUs
parameters.help_zh: vCPU数量
parameters.name: cpu_count

parameters.help_en: The memory size. Unit: MiB
parameters.help_zh: 内存大小。单位为MiB
parameters.name: memory_size

parameters.help_en: The number of GPU cores
parameters.help_zh: GPU核数
parameters.name: gpu_count

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer for which you want to change the specification. If this parameter is specified, the response includes compatibility information between the specification and the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 变配时传入需要变配的云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与云电脑之间是否兼容的信息
parameters.name: desktop_id_for_modify

parameters.help_en: The order type
parameters.help_zh: 订单类型
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The applicable scope of the specification. Default value: `Public`
parameters.help_zh: 规格适用范围。默认值：`Public`
parameters.name: applied_scope

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud computer for which you want to change the specification. If this parameter is specified, the response includes compatibility information between the specification and the shared cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 变配时传入需要变配的共享型云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与共享型云电脑之间是否兼容的信息
parameters.name: desktop_group_id_for_modify

parameters.help_en: The GPU driver type
parameters.help_zh: GPU驱动类型
parameters.name: gpu_driver_type

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results. If this parameter is not specified, results are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，若不指定则按照创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the specification
parameters.help_zh: 规格的售卖方式
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The list of specification IDs
parameters.help_zh: 规格ID列表
parameters.name: desktop_type_id_list

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of multi-sessions supported by the specification
parameters.help_zh: 查询规则支持的多会话数量
parameters.name: support_min_session_count

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数未对外开放使用
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The GPU memory size. This parameter is meaningful only for GPU-accelerated cloud computers. Unit: MB
parameters.help_zh: 显存大小。对于GPU型云电脑，该返回值有实际意义。单位：MB
parameters.name: gpu_memory

parameters.help_en: The list of applicable scopes
parameters.help_zh: 适用范围列表
parameters.name: scope_set

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network to which the shared cloud computer belongs
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The scenarios of the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑的使用场景
parameters.name: desktop_scenario

DataDiskSize.description_en: The data cloud disk size. Unit: GiB

Description.description_en: The description of the NAS file system

DesktopTypeStatus.description_en: The specification status. A value of `SUFFICIENT` indicates that the specification resources are sufficient
DesktopTypeStatus.description_zh: 规格状态。返回`SUFFICIENT`时表示该规格资源充足

EnvId.description_en: The environment ID. This parameter is not publicly available

EnvType.description_en: The environment type. This parameter is not publicly available

GpuMemory.description_en: The GPU memory size. This parameter is meaningful only for GPU-accelerated cloud computers. Unit: MB
GpuMemory.description_zh: 显存大小。对于GPU型云电脑，该返回值有实际意义。单位：MB

MaxSessionCount.description_en: The number of multi-sessions supported by the current specification
MaxSessionCount.description_zh: 当前规格支持的多会话数量

SaleTypes.description_en: The supported desktop type sale categories
SaleTypes.description_zh: 支持的桌面类型销售种类
SaleTypes.title_en: 支持的桌面类型销售种类
SaleTypes.title_zh: 支持的桌面类型销售种类

Scopes.description_en: The list of billing methods for the specification

items.description_en: The billing method of the specification

SystemDiskSize.description_en: The system cloud disk size. Unit: GiB
